summary: Iteration 52 — Verified 'local coupon — FREE founder perk' feature + chain band + tier picker + Spanish + spin/reveal exclusion regression. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. Backend: GET /api/coupons/chains-nearby?category=food&limit=3 returns both Burrito Bandito (chain, FORK20) and E2E Test Diner (local/legacy, FATE10); adding &exclude=<diner-id> correctly removes the diner (verified via curl). Frontend Home: [data-testid=local-coupon-perk-line] present ('Includes your coupon on winning reveals — FREE founder perk'); NEW [data-testid=chain-business-band] renders under the local band with 'FOR CHAINS & FRANCHISES' pill, $99/mo, $990/yr + '2 months free' badge; [data-testid=chain-business-cta] → /sponsor/chains pitch page loads with 'Your coupon, on every plate fate deals'. Sponsor dialog (opened via [data-testid=become-sponsor-button]): [data-testid=sponsor-tier-picker] shows 'Local spot $19/mo · + FREE coupon' and 'Chain coupon $99/mo'; default local view renders [data-testid=sponsor-local-coupon-section] (green) with [data-testid=local-coupon-free-badge] 'FREE — founder perk'; switching to [data-testid=sponsor-tier-chain] swaps to [data-testid=sponsor-coupon-section] (amber, required) and shows $99/$990 plan cards (local section removed from DOM). Validation: on local tier, filling name+cuisine+email+coupon-code with EMPTY description → subscribe click shows toast 'Add a short offer description for your coupon' and the dialog stays open (no redirect). Spanish (localStorage ff_lang=es): perk pill translates to 'Incluye tu cupón en las revelaciones ganadoras — ventaja de fundador GRATIS', chain band → 'PARA CADENAS Y FRANQUICIAS' + 'Tu cupón, en cada plato que reparte el destino', sponsor dialog free-badge → 'GRATIS — ventaja de fundador', and empty-description validation toast → 'Agrega una breve descripción de la oferta de tu cupón' (dialog stays open). Footer: [data-testid=footer-chain-link] present pointing to /sponsor/chains; [data-testid=sponsor-faq-button] opens [data-testid=sponsor-faq-dialog] with 6 questions including 'How does the free local coupon work?'. SPIN/REVEAL REGRESSION (highest priority): ZIP 10001 → Food (default) → Deal → shuffle completes → reveal card renders without errors. Case A (winner NOT sponsored, e.g. Capizzi randomly picked): [data-testid=chain-coupon-strip] correctly shows E2E TEST DINER · FATE10 (or Burrito · FORK20) — either allowed. Case B (winner IS sponsored, forced by tapping the E2E Test Diner alternative in '3 More to Consider' which calls onPick → re-renders reveal with E2E Test Diner as winner): winner card shows SPONSORED badge and inline CouponReveal scratch card (winner's own FATE10); [data-testid=chain-coupon-strip] now shows 'BONUS OFFER NEARBY · BURRITO BANDITO' with FORK20 — FATE10 is CORRECTLY EXCLUDED from the strip because the winner's excludeId (diner id) is passed to ChainCouponStrip. Zero app-level console errors during any of the tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: BecomeSponsorDialog.jsx: sponsor-coupon-code data-testid is duplicated across BOTH the chain-tier coupon section (line ~326) and local-tier coupon section (line ~348). When both sections could exist in DOM simultaneously (they don't currently because they're conditionally rendered), this would cause locator ambiguity. Playwright tests worked because only one section is mounted at a time via ternary — but consider prefixing (e.g., sponsor-local-coupon-code / sponsor-chain-coupon-code) for defensive testability. Same applies to sponsor-coupon-description and sponsor-coupon-terms.

RevealStage.jsx line 231: ChainCouponStrip excludeId is passed as card.sponsored ? card.id : undefined — clean and correct. Verified behavior in browser: strip swaps from FATE10 (unsponsored winner Capizzi) to FORK20 (sponsored winner E2E Test Diner picked).
HomeInfoSections.jsx chain-business-band: uses inline hex colors instead of tailwind theme tokens (repeat comment from prior iterations) — non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home bands, sponsor dialog tier picker + local/chain swap + validation toast EN & ES, footer FAQ + chain link, /sponsor/chains pitch page, and both spin/reveal cases — sponsored & unsponsored winner with correct ChainCouponStrip exclusion)

test_credentials: None required for this feature. Sponsors already seeded: E2E Test Diner (id=0d8793b2-2e76-4e6d-a814-4ab35f2326f9, FATE10), Burrito Bandito (id=test-chain-sponsor-1, FORK20).
seed_data_creation: None. Fate-dealt counter incremented 1680→1682 during two spin tests (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To force E2E Test Diner as the reveal winner deterministically (rather than relying on random pinning), do a normal spin then click [data-testid=alternative-0d8793b2-2e76-4e6d-a814-4ab35f2326f9] in the '3 More to Consider' list — this triggers onPick and re-renders the reveal with the picked place as the winner card (SPONSORED badge + inline scratch coupon). The ChainCouponStrip then re-renders with excludeId=card.id and swaps to the other sponsor's coupon (FORK20). CouponReveal renders as a canvas 'Scratch to reveal your deal' — text 'FATE10'/'FORK20' is only exposed once scratched OR after the tap-to-reveal is triggered; the coupon code text IS present in the DOM inside [data-testid=coupon-reveal] (or strip container) — verified via inner_text. To skip both overlays: set localStorage ff_theme_chosen='1', ff_intro_seen='1', ff_guided_intro_seen='1', ff_intro_done='1'; if guided intro still shows, click 'Skip intro' (EN) / 'Saltar intro' (ES). Language toggle [data-testid=lang-es]/[data-testid=lang-en] persists via localStorage.ff_lang.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature ships as spec'd.
